title: Choose the visual world
question: You already pinned iOS Liquid Glass Dark — that beats the roll if you confirm it (pick Steer and type that, or say so in chat). Otherwise keep the roll, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Locker Mirror Bay
options.lineage: Gym locker-room mirrors under cool fluorescent light
options.thesis: The workout UI as a black-tile mirror: chrome edge, double reflection, cool lamp wash — glass you train in front of.
options.viewport: Phone: sticky glass top bar over dark tile; workout cards as mirror panes with specular top edge; lime only on primary Start/Done.
options.risk: Can read cold and locker-room literal if reflections overpower the GIF catalog.
options.case: Assigned by the roll. Strong gym audience ID; Operate clarity is high if chrome stays secondary to exercises.

options.label: Course Over Terrain
options.lineage: ISO orienteering map + purple course overlay
options.thesis: Muscle filters are terrain; the active plan is the purple course riding above — punch controls as you complete sets.
options.viewport: Library as map legend + terrain; active workout as numbered purple leg over the catalog ground.
options.risk: Light map ground fights your dark Liquid Glass pin; mid-set phone use wants fewer map metaphors.
options.case: Fuses poorly because PRODUCT brand commitment is dark Liquid Glass and map inks want a light paper ground.

options.label: Catalog Pages
options.thesis: Every exercise is a keyed page; the catalog is an index you punch into, not a feed you scroll.
options.viewport: Rigid page header with page number; body as 40-cell rows; GIFs as mosaic blocks until focused.
options.risk: Bitmap grid fights GIF-first proof and Hebrew RTL fluidity.
options.case: Strong Operate clarity for indexing; weak audience ID for gym/home mid-set and conflicts with refractive glass.

options.label: Leather Studio Shelf
options.thesis: Plans as bound volumes on a warm shelf; progress as a stitched seam filling in.
options.viewport: Shelf of plan spines; open a volume to the day's exercises as paper pages.
options.risk: Warm skeuomorph is the opposite of dark Liquid Glass and slow for one-thumb gym use.
options.case: Fuses poorly because leather/linen warmth contradicts the pinned dark glass material and gym phone context.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark fitness app done impeccably: solid panels, one neon accent, bottom tab bar, card list of exercises.
canonCard.viewport: Top title, filter chips, scrollable exercise cards, bottom tabs — the arrangement users expect from training apps.
canonCard.risk: Safe and forgettable; easy to confuse with any gym template.
